text: Tenderer must hold a valid LUSA qualification for the relevant field of activity.
Tenderer must hold valid liability insurance for its operations with cover of at least EUR 1,000,000.
Tenderer's equity ratio must be at least 20%.
Tenderer's revenue must be at least EUR 3,000,000 in the most recent financial year.
Response times for corrective maintenance (korjaavan kunnossapidon vasteajat) must be addressed.
Servicing of refrigeration equipment (F-gas) must be addressed.
A subcontracting management plan must be addressed.
Handover of the asset register and documentation must be addressed.
Service level targets (SLA) must be addressed.
Commissioning and testing procedure must be addressed.
Condition-monitoring data collection must be addressed.
Worker qualification requirements on site must be addressed.
Access control and security at the contracting authority's premises must be addressed.
Pricing currency must be addressed.
Transparency of subcontractor costs must be addressed.
A cost breakdown requirement must be addressed.
Contractual penalty for shortfall against the service level must be addressed.
CVs of key personnel must be enclosed with the tender.
A trade register extract (kaupparekisteriote) must be enclosed with the tender.
Unit basis for maintenance pricing (per property vs. per square metre) must be stated as required.
Rounding practice: figures must be given to two decimal places.
Reference currency for framework agreement pricing must be stated as required.
Submission deadline time zone and exact time must be observed (19 October 2026, 12:00 EET).
Energy-efficiency measures must be addressed.
Escalation procedure for unresolved faults must be addressed.
Quality control and testing procedures must be addressed.
A preventive maintenance plan must be addressed.

Binding, non-negotiable condition: if the tenderer cannot demonstrate round-the-clock (24/7) on-call duty within Finland, the tender will be rejected regardless of price, irrespective of any other merit.
Retention percentage (pidatysprosentti) must be addressed.
